rationale: Eight feeds are waiting, so worker count must rise above 1 to reduce the backlog. However, all workers share one upstream account, which is the single sustainability ceiling. No load test or account-limit change is on record to justify saturating that account with all 8 workers simultaneously. Four workers quadruples current throughput and meaningfully clears the queue while keeping concurrent upstream pressure at half the theoretical maximum — the highest choice that is defensible as sustainable under the documented single-account constraint.
